Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
C. I. D.
K. O. REG
No 563
Date 9 - 9 16
7th September 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that on the 6th inst General Yang
sent a telegram to Peking reporting the presence in
Shanghai of a large number of the Manchu Monarchist
Restoration Party. He suggested that the Foreign
Ministers be approached for co-operation with a view
to their suppression.

In spite of orders from Peking, the Detective
Bureau controlled by General Chang Hsun with head-
quarters at No. Ling Ying Road, West Gate, is still
in existence.
On the 6th inst Han Hwe 韓恢, the so called
Labour leader, sent a vigorously worded telegram to
General Chang Hsun, asking him to withdraw these
men or he himself will take steps to suppress them.

The Rebel leaders have decided to open two offices,
one in Frenchtown and the other in the city, to deal
with the repatriation of rebels which will commence
in the near future.

General Tsai Ao underwent a successful operation
at the Paulun Hospital on the 6th instant.

The painters' strike is still on,

Your obedient servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
上海工部局。
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处。
（侦探股。）
刑事侦缉处。
K. O. 登记
第 563 号
日期 16年9月9日

1916年9月7日。

先生：

据报，本月6日，杨将军致电北京，报告上海有大量满清复辟党人活动。他建议与各国公使接洽，寻求合作以图镇压该党。

尽管北京已下达命令，但由张勋将军控制、总部设在西门灵英路（音译）No. Ling Ying Road 的侦探局依然存在。

本月6日，所谓劳工领袖韩恢致电张勋将军，措辞激烈，要求他撤走这些人，否则他将亲自采取措施予以镇压。

叛乱首领已决定开设两处办事处，一处位于法租界，另一处位于华界城区，以处理即将于近期开始的叛乱分子遣返事宜。

蔡锷将军于本月6日在宝隆医院成功接受手术。

油漆工罢工仍在继续。

您顺从的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监警司。
